title: breachsafe-ux tool descriptor
description: One tool = one YAML under tools/<id>/<id>.yaml. The host renders it, builds a no-shell argv, runs the tool, runs an external validator, and derives the 3-state badge. See docs/adr/0002-host-descriptor-boundary.md.

schema_version.description: Descriptor schema version. Absent is treated as 1 (see #49).

id.description: Slug; must match the tools/<id>/<id>.yaml directory and file name.

standalone.description: false = chain-only (reached via another tool's action button; no own tab).

brand.description: Display-only header/footer metadata. String values may reference env vars (e.g. ${QUREDDY_VERSION}); expanded before render, never in run/validate argv.

version_cmd.description: Display-only: run this to derive the shown version from the installed tool (single-source, #51); falls back to `version`. Env single-sourcing also works via version: "${VAR}".

input.description: A form field. It maps to argv by AT MOST ONE of positional/flag/arg; an input with none is a token-only value referenced via {name} in run.positional_from / run.argv / validate.argv (e.g. host, port composed into positional_from).

run.description: How the tool is executed (no shell). Exactly one of base/argv.

base.description: Fixed command prefix, e.g. [qureddy, scan, tls]. Options + positionals are appended.

argv.description: Fully static argv; no input-driven assembly. Tokens: {name} = an input value; engine-provided {share} {workdir} {artifact} {artifact_name} {python}. {{ and }} are literal braces. See docs/descriptor-tokens.md.

positional_from.description: Compose one positional from a template, e.g. {host}:{port}.

artifact_from.description: Where the artifact comes from; omit if the tool writes the artifact file itself.

image.description: Docker image; the tool binary is the ENTRYPOINT. Pin by @sha256.

trust_artifact_on_nonzero.description: Opt in: a nonzero exit may still badge from the artifact (default: nonzero -> unavailable).

no_end_of_options.description: Opt out of the '--' end-of-options guard (weaker posture; for tools whose parser does not support '--').

validate.description: External validator: runs its own process against the artifact and yields the honest verdict.

argv.description: Validator argv. Tokens: engine-provided {share} {workdir} {artifact} {artifact_name} {stdout_file} {python}. {{ and }} are literal braces. See docs/descriptor-tokens.md.

badge_rule.description: Maps validator output to a badge state. Fail-closed: an empty/unknown condition never passes.

condition.description: All present sub-conditions must hold (AND). An empty condition is rejected (fail-closed).

action.description: A descriptor-declared button that runs its own argv against the inputs and shows OK/FAIL. Generalizes the old preflight/'Test connection' button (argv, not a host function).

argv.description: Action argv template. Same token namespace as run.argv (see docs/descriptor-tokens.md); stdin is closed.

chain.description: Hand this tool's artifact to another descriptor via a button.
